Class WaterManager

java.lang.Object
com.mygame.water.WaterManager
public class WaterManager extends Object
Configures and updates the jMonkeyEngine water filter and its post-processing pipeline.

    • WaterManager

      public WaterManager(com.jme3.scene.Node reflectionScene, com.jme3.asset.AssetManager assets, com.jme3.renderer.ViewPort viewPort, com.jme3.math.Vector3f sunDirection, GameConfig config, WindModel wind)
      Creates a water manager using the scene, viewport, lighting direction, and settings supplied.
      Parameters:
      reflectionScene - scene rendered into the water reflection
      assets - engine asset manager
      viewPort - viewport that receives the water post-processing filter
      sunDirection - initial direction of the sun rays
      config - validated runtime settings
      wind - shared deterministic wind model
